programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.desc: The Lord of Lancaster asserts his reign by levying tariffs on the little people; Lisa & Kerri stitch together some antique accoutrements; Dusty & Lupe spot some gold in an immense locker; Kenny finally finds himself some decent profit.

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.desc: Back in Montebello, Kenny is determined to stop swearing by carrying around a cuss counter; Dave goes in big on a high-end locker; Ivy doesn't hit the bullseye when it counts; Dusty and Lupe hope to hear the pristine sounds of success.

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.sub_title: The Slings and Arrows of Outrageous Lockers
programs.desc: The city of Hemet reminds Kenny of a certain English poet, but he ends up focusing on the Eastern arts; Ivy spreads holiday joy as he battles it out with a new buyer who isn't all that intimidated.

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.desc: The Lord of Lancaster tries to levy tariffs on his visitors, but Dusty & Lupe manage to distract him long enough to cut out a profit; Dave is finally able to see the light. Kenny's new friends fit him like a glove.

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.sub_title: Back to the Locker: Stranger Finds
programs.desc: A routine day of storage auctions turns bizarre when buyers uncover eerie voodoo relics, strange medical devices, and bizarre snakeskin oddities; will these creepy finds turn to junk or treasures?

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.desc: Torrance gives props to Dusty & Lupe who are haunted by their locker; Kenny manages to kill several birds with one locker; Brandi gets all medieval with some strange music boxes, while Lisa re-joins the rest of the fleas to drop some new records.

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.desc: In Orange, Dave zeroes in on a stack of Benjamins; Dusty and Lupe go really big and manage to stay out of the weeds; Mary gets herself all chakra'd in Fullerton, while she and her Texas Teammate Lisa spawn some seriously spirited stuff.

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.desc: Everything is coming up "Brandi" in Banning, as she milks all she can out of her buy; Ivy knows good tools when he sees them; Lisa forms some sweet success out of an otherwise bland unit, while Kenny scores on a highbrow horseplay hoard.
